description: Builds a behavioral profile for a specific account: total transaction count, total volume, average amount, unique counterparties, and transaction type breakdown over a lookback period.

configuration.query: FROM fraud-* | WHERE wire.direction == "outbound" | STATS wire_count = COUNT(*), total_wired = SUM(event.amount) BY account.name, wire.outbound.bank_name, wire.outbound.country | SORT total_wired DESC | LIMIT 50
